summary: Well‑executed, preregistered paired confirmatory study that instrumented a generate–verify–repair (GVR) pipeline (gpt‑5‑mini + deterministic validator + ≤1 automated repair) on 300 intent→CLI tasks with shared_initial_candidate semantics. Analysis artifacts, raw outputs, execution manifest, and required master‑prompt provenance are archived. Primary confirmatory test (exact McNemar) on 266 complete pairs yields a small absolute improvement (≈0.0188) that does not meet the preregistered α=0.05 decision rule (p=0.0625); a paired bootstrap CI (B=10,000) narrowly excludes zero. The manuscript correctly discloses shared_initial_candidate semantics, preregistration, missingness, and nondeterminism. Reproducibility artifacts and hashes are provided. Main remaining defects are editorial / bibliographic (IEEE reference formatting and explicit citation-to-claim verification).
critical_issues: References section is not presented as a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography with complete bibliographic metadata for each cited work (authors, full title, venue, year) despite verified records being available in the evidence bundle. This must be corrected.

Manuscript must ensure that every numbered in-text citation corresponds to and actually supports the proximate scholarly claim; the reviewer could not confirm this mapping from the current prose + cited_record_ids alone.
required_revisions: Replace the References section with a standard IEEE‑style, numbered bibliography using the verified bibliographic metadata available in the archived/verifier records (authors, full title, venue, year, DOI/arXiv where applicable). Do not leave bare DOIs or ambiguous 'Proc. (2024)' placeholders.

Update in-text citation markers (use IEEE numeric brackets) to match the new numbered References and confirm, for each citation, that the cited source actually supports the immediate claim in the surrounding text; correct or remove any mismatches. Provide no new experiments — use only archived verified metadata/artifacts to complete this edit.
optional_revisions: In Related Work or Methods briefly cite the exact Batfish/header‑space or verification papers from the archived bibliography entries (full citation) to strengthen the grounding of the deterministic validator choice.

Add a one‑sentence explicit rationale in Methods for why the paired bootstrap CI method was included alongside the preregistered exact McNemar test and reiterate the discrete‑sample explanation for the observed p/CI discrepancy (this is explanatory, not a new analysis).
